scope: All ten missiles / 140 descriptors; source review before runtime decisions
palette_source: _MS/BUTTONS.256 runtime palette; embedded missile palettes are grayscale placeholders
cultural_scope: Complete Braccatian CDB and functional mappings reviewed previously; original bytes revalidated here. Bronze Age analogy does not identify an alloy or require decorative missile machinery. No mapped per-missile narrative exists beyond catalogue name/effect-role evidence.
scitek_scope: The completed 36-subject audit contains no Braccatian preview binding. Generic/other-culture technical films do not establish missing Braccatian missile geometry or operating motion.

records.name: Mega Blast
records.observed: Two broad gold expansions separated by a thin banded waist, copper forward neck and gold terminals.
records.review: All fourteen correctly paletted descriptors visually reviewed. Descriptors 0-6 provide heading changes, 7-9 body/reveal states and 10-13 the body plus bright exhaust. Exhaust is not solid missile geometry. Exact historical frame sequencing/timing is not newly recovered here.
records.candidate_decision: Retain pending fresh native/independent GLB and render review: major visible form/colour regions already present; do not invent subpixel machinery.
records.uncertainty: Exact transverse profiles, hidden sections, alloy identity and detailed projection remain authored. Comms Killer faceting and HotBomb casting cross-sections are existing interpretations, not proven by tiny sprites.
